description: How long a sofa should be for a wall (about two-thirds of it; half to two-thirds is the range), what kind of sofa that is, the clearances around it, and the largest smallest-dimension that fits through a door. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

door.description: Width of the narrowest door on the way in, in inches. Default 32.

wall.description: Length of the wall the sofa goes against, in feet.

name: sofa_size
title: Sofa size calculator
